kicker: Pitch to clients abroad · from Thursday
title: Five checks before we publish a pitch.
subtitle: Free to pitch. Free to apply. We expect to reject seven in ten, and we will say so.
items: A real LinkedIn profile: your face, your name, and work history with dates.
One service, for one kind of client. Not 'we do everything'.
A proof link that opens: a Loom, a live demo, or a public case study.
A price, in US dollars. 'Depends' is not a price.
You answer our test message within 24 hours.
